purpose: Public, machine-readable and human-readable discovery layer for governed osteosarcoma therapeutic research hypotheses.
public_boundary: This repository publishes research hypotheses only. It must not publish private clinical context, patient information, credentials, restricted evidence, medical advice or treatment recommendations.

ecosystem_integration.discovery_rule: Authorised agents must resolve the canonical EduLinked repository ecosystem registry and existing Universal Research Engine federation capability before creating new research, evidence, provenance or publication machinery.
ecosystem_integration.private_routing_rule: Private repository topology and restricted source content are intentionally not embedded in this public manifest. Resolve private/source-owned routing only through authorised ecosystem systems.
ecosystem_integration.authority_rule: Candidate evidence generation, export success, validation success and generated projections do not transfer scientific-review, clinical-use or publication authority.

evidence_model: Evidence bindings classify public sources as SUPPORTS, CONTRADICTS, LIMITS, CONTEXTUALISES, FAILED_REPLICATION or SUCCESSOR_CONTEXT and preserve uncertainty, maturity, acceptance state and provenance.
update_mechanism: Canonical hypothesis objects are rendered through scripts/render-public-research.js; CI verifies generated-output freshness and validates public research boundaries before deployment.

publication_status_semantics.public-research-candidate: Public-safe research hypothesis requiring scientific review.
publication_status_semantics.reviewed-public-hypothesis: Public-safe hypothesis reviewed under the repository authority model.
publication_status_semantics.superseded: Retained historical object replaced by a successor interpretation.
publication_status_semantics.withdrawn: Retained historical object no longer appropriate for active publication.

licensing: Not yet established in repository metadata.
